title: Brother-In-Law Stole $115K Inheritance, Left Me $5K. So I Got My Farm Back, Now He Works For Me.
description: When my brother-in-law forged a dissolution and sold the Christmas tree farm I inherited, he left me a $5,000 stump check. I retrieved the original partnership document from a hollow ornament and voided the sale. Now I run Tannenbaum of Betrayal Tree Farm, and Gary trims trees in a vest that says 'Needled by Fraud.' #RevengeStory #FarmBetrayal #ChristmasTreeFarm
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY FARM, NOW HE'S NEEDLED BY FRAUD
pinned_comment: If your brother-in-law forged a dissolution, sold your $115K inheritance farm and left you a $5,000 stump check, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments!
